subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Should the gateway adopt a 4096-entry LRU pricing-cache retention policy once the implementation demonstrably preserves recently used rows across catalog growth?
rationale: The cap intentionally trades complete catalog retention for bounded memory; the code defect is repairable, but the permanent capacity and eviction contract needs gateway-owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept bounded LRU after repair
options.body: Fix the insertion order, add the overlap-plus-large-catalog regression test, and merge only after redacted live refresh evidence confirms the approved 4096-entry policy.

options.title: Choose a different retention contract
options.body: Set a different capacity or catalog-retention strategy if 4096 entries is not appropriate for supported dynamic provider catalogs.

options.title: Pause the cache policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers do not want model-pricing lookups to trade full catalog retention for bounded memory.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded LRU after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the insertion order, add the overlap-plus-large-catalog regression test, and merge only after redacted live refresh evidence confirms the approved 4096-entry policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway pricing work and related cache discussion make this the best available owner for the retention-policy decision.
